sentences.text: Brasilosuchus was an extinct reptile belonging to the superfamily Crocodyloidea.
This animal lived in Brazil during the Miocene epoch, specifically within the Tortonian stage between 11.63 and 7.246 million years ago.
The genus contains only one known species, Brasilosuchus mendesi, which serves as the type species for the group.
The genus and its sole species were named by Jonas Souza-Filho and Jean Bocquentin-Villanueva in 1989.
Researchers later tentatively re-identified the animal as a species of Charactosuchus in an unpublished 1993 conference abstract.
It is possible that Brasilosuchus belongs to the subfamily Tomistominae, though this has not been confirmed by phylogenetic analysis.
